battle.name: 普丹戰爭
battle.theater: 石勒蘇益格與荷爾斯泰因
battle.brief: 一八六四年二月，普魯士聯同奧地利越過埃德河，開啟第二次石勒蘇益格戰爭。丹麥以法系雷管步槍一脈的一八四九式步槍固守迪弗爾與日德蘭海灣要塞，普軍則靠針刺火槍的射速與重炮封鎖取勝，最後以連夜轟擊哥本哈根逼出停戰。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的基本格局是兩個聯盟對一個王國。普魯士與奧地利組成聯邦執行軍的一面：普魯士王國陸軍投入第九、第十與第十一軍團的步兵團、炮兵與預備隊，奧地利帝國軍隊派出第九軍團所屬的匈牙利 Banat 步兵團與隨軍騎兵、炮兵分遣隊，兩軍由邦聯執行軍司令部統一編制，實際戰術指揮多由普軍將領擔當；普魯士海軍波羅的海分艦隊在丹麥海岸封鎖，並以海軍陸戰隊奪取弗萊德里西亞等海灣據點，奧地利海軍則以裝甲巡洋艦與螺旋槳巡洋艦在波羅的海與亞得里亞海之間巡弋。丹麥一方是丹麥王國陸軍與皇家海軍：陸軍以第一師及所屬各旅在西日德蘭半島沿沼澤、灣岸與島嶼構成縱深防線，海軍擁有當時世界上第一艘可航行的裝甲戰艦『羅夫·克拉克』號，另有弗萊德里西亞、卡斯特萊特、特雷克羅納與弗拉克堡等海灣要塞，砲兵以自英國購得的線膛後膛砲為主，別有商船改裝的武裝與沿岸漁船徵用。背景層面則是德意志邦聯：石勒蘇益格與荷爾斯泰因兩公國的等級議會與地產代表向邦聯陳情，邦聯議會於一八六四年六月決議執行邦聯法，於是原本處理內部事務的邦聯機構變成了聯軍的授權來源；英、法、俄等《倫敦議定書》簽署國宣布中立，瑞典與挪威保持觀望，戰事因此被限制在日德蘭半島與丹麥本土。
countriesEn: The basic shape of the war was two alliances against one kingdom. On one side stood Prussia and Austria, formed into the federal execution corps: the Prussian army put in the infantry, artillery and reserve of the IX, X and XI Corps, while the Austrian imperial army sent a detachment of the Hungarian Banat Regiment with its cavalry and artillery from the IX Corps. The two were unified under the command of the federal execution corps, though the tactical direction in practice was largely in the hands of Prussian generals. The Prussian Baltic squadron blockaded the Danish coast and its marines took such lagoon towns as Fredericia, while the Austrian navy cruised between the Baltic and the Adriatic with armoured frigates and screw corvettes. On the other side stood the army and the royal navy of Denmark. The field army formed the First Division and its brigades in a deep line along the marshes, the bays and the islands of the western Jutland peninsula. The navy possessed what was then the world's first sea-going armoured warship, Rolf Krake, and the lagoon fortresses of Fredericia, Kastellet, Trekroner and Flakfortet, with coastal artillery built mainly around rifled breech-loading guns bought in England; there were also armed merchant vessels and requisitioned fishing boats along the shore. Behind all of this stood the German Confederation. The estates and the estates' assemblies of the duchies of Schleswig and Holstein petitioned the Confederation, and in June 1864 the Confederation Diet resolved to carry out federal execution, so that a body created to handle internal business turned into the legal warrant for the invading army. Britain, France and Russia, the signatories of the London Protocol, declared neutrality, and Sweden and Norway watched, so that the fighting was confined to the Jutland peninsula and to Denmark itself.
people: 普魯士一方的關鍵人物集中在政治與參謀兩層。國王威廉一世起初對開戰猶豫不決，最後在宰相勸說下同意；奧托·馮·俾斯麥是全部動作的推動者，他以『鐵與血』而不是自由派所期望的議會程序來處理邦聯衝突，並在德國議會演說中把這場戰爭定義為執行邦聯法，而非對丹麥的兼併。陸軍大臣阿爾布雷希特·馮·羅恩主持動員與裝備供應，總參謀長希爾德·馮·莫爾擬訂石勒蘇益格戰役計畫，主張以封鎖、圍城砲兵與針刺火槍的射速取代正面強攻，他的兒子小莫爾當時在軍中服役並於同年陣亡。聯邦執行軍由路德維希·馮·布雷澤-維尼亞里率領，攻擊迪弗爾的普軍第一師由瓦蘭格爾指揮，一八六四年四月十八日強攻失利，據說正是因為一名普軍參謀官上報迪弗爾要塞不可強攻，使指揮部在關鍵時猶豫。丹麥方面，國王克里斯蒂安九世主持國策，首相兼外交大臣莫納代表丹麥在倫敦會議與普方交涉，陸軍由迪特列夫·馮·比隆指揮，沿海防線與伊斯特德戰役的部署出自他手；海軍以鐵甲艦『羅夫·克拉克』號最為人所知，其指揮官蘇恩森上校在弗倫斯堡外海主導了撞擊『拉德茨基』號一役。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Prussian side sat in two layers, politics and the general staff. King William I hesitated at first and was talked into the war by his chancellor. Otto von Bismarck drove every step of it, choosing blood and iron over the parliamentary procedure the liberals expected, and in the German Diet he defined the war as the execution of federal law rather than the annexation of Denmark. The Minister of War Albrecht von Roon ran the mobilisation and the supply of equipment, while the Chief of the General Staff, Helmuth von Moltke the Elder, drew up the campaign plan for Schleswig, arguing for blockade, siege artillery and the rate of fire of the needle gun in place of a frontal assault. His son, the younger Moltke, was serving in the army and was killed in the same year. The federal execution corps was led by Ludwig von Brese-Winiary, and the Prussian First Division, which attacked Dybbol, was commanded by Wrangel. The assault of 18 April 1864 failed, reportedly because a Prussian staff officer reported that the Dybbol works could not be taken by storm, which made the command hesitate at the decisive moment. On the Danish side, King Christian IX directed the policy of the state, and the prime minister and foreign minister Monrad represented Denmark in the London negotiations with the Prussians. The army was commanded by Ditlev von Bülow, who laid out the coastal defence and the deployment at Isted. In the navy the ironclad Rolf Krake was the best-known vessel, and its commander, Captain Suenson, led the ramming of the Radetzky off Flensburg.
kits: 這張卡上的雷管步槍屬於法系的雷管步槍一類，以法軍一八四〇年型步兵步槍為代表：口徑約十四毫米，槍管初階仍為滑膛，擊發機改用雷管，底火經擊錘撞擊自行點燃，無須火繩與燧石，因此在北日德蘭冬季的潮濕、濃霧與逆光環境中仍能可靠擊發，代價是初速稍低、槍機零件較多、維修更繁。戰爭中這類武器正是交戰雙方共同的技術底色。丹麥陸軍的骨幹武器是一八四九式步槍，口徑約十五點九毫米、膛線數條，以散裝藥包配紙包底火發射，有效射程約三百米，雖然射程與精度已不及新一代步槍，但射擊可靠、在濕冷氣候下故障率低，一八六四年後仍是丹麥軍的制式槍械；正因為有這種守得住的步槍，丹麥才能以築城固守的戰術拖住進攻方。普魯士方面，針刺火槍已裝備多數前線步兵，紙包定裝藥令每分鐘可射數發，射程與精度亦佳；但普軍仍保留大量改裝自火燧時代的雷管步槍與舊式滑膛槍，專供後方、守備與第二線任務。砲兵方面，普軍步兵配六磅線膛野戰砲，圍城階段集中十二磅與二十四磅攻城砲，聯邦執行軍在迪弗爾與哥本哈根方向投入逾二百門火砲；丹麥海防以英製二十四磅線膛後膛砲安裝在海灣要塞，鐵甲艦『羅夫·克拉克』號裝四門二十四磅砲，另有螺旋槳巡洋艦與水雷。運輸與補給同樣吃重：基爾至弗倫斯堡的鐵路把普軍後方與前線連成主幹，軍用馬車隊與蒸汽拖船分擔沿海岸的橫向輸送，冬季港口結冰使北方戰線的補給時間拉長。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card belongs to the French family of percussion arms, represented by the French infantry musket of 1840: a calibre of about fourteen millimetres, the barrel still smooth-bored at the first stage, the lock changed over to percussion, with a primer struck by the hammer and a cap that ignites by itself, so that no burning match and no flint are needed. It therefore fired reliably in the damp, foggy and backlit winter of northern Jutland, at the price of a slightly lower muzzle velocity, more lock components and more complicated maintenance. In this war that class of weapon was the common technical background of both sides. The backbone of the Danish army was the rifle of 1849, of fifteen point nine millimetres calibre with seven grooves, fired with loose powder and paper cartridges, with an effective range of about three hundred metres. Its range and accuracy were already behind the newer rifles, but it shot reliably and had a low rate of failure in wet cold weather, and it remained the standard arm of the Danish army after 1864; precisely because of such a musket that could be relied upon, Denmark was able to hold on with a policy of fortified defence. On the Prussian side the needle gun was already in the hands of most of the front-line infantry, and the paper cartridge raised the rate of fire to several rounds a minute with good range and accuracy; yet the Prussian army still kept large numbers of percussion muskets converted from the flintlock era and old smoothbores, for rear-area, garrison and second-line duties. On the artillery side the Prussian infantry had six-pounder rifled field guns, and the siege phase brought up twelve- and twenty-four-pounder siege guns, with the federal execution corps committing more than two hundred pieces against Dybbol and Copenhagen. The Danish coastal defence used British twenty-four-pounder rifled breech-loaders mounted in the lagoon fortresses; the ironclad Rolf Krake carried four twenty-four-pounders, with screw corvettes and mines besides. Transport and supply were equally weighty: the railway from Kiel to Flensburg tied the Prussian rear areas to the front, army wagons and steam tugs took over the lateral movement along the coast, and ice in the northern ports lengthened the time of resupply on that line.
tactics: 普丹戰爭的戰術主軸是『遠射與工事』對『築城固守』。普軍放棄一八一四三年那樣的密集方陣，以連為單位的散兵線在塹壕、樹線與村舍後方射擊，針刺火槍每分鐘數發的齊射彈著點密集而射速高，丹麥守軍一旦離開堡壘就難以維持，因此普軍把重心放在封鎖與圍城砲兵，而不是立即強攻。四月十八日對迪弗爾的第一次總攻是普軍唯一一次正面衝鋒，結果失利：丹軍以堡壘射界、反衝擊與步兵援護把進攻方打了回去，聯軍在堡壘前丟下數百人。之後普軍改採逐步接近、開挖壕溝、架設六十門以上重砲的圍城法，三月三十日的大規模轟擊加上一系列夜襲，終於逼使迪弗爾守軍在五月四日至五日之間主動撤出並炸毀工事，而不是被強攻拿下。丹麥的戰術核心是守住海灣與島嶼要塞、把普軍拖入持久戰：海軍以鐵甲艦在松茲海峽橫掃，阻止普軍由海路登陸，四月二十九日在弗倫斯堡外海更以撞角撞傷奧地利裝甲巡洋艦『拉德茨基』號的機艙與舵，迫其退出戰鬥數月。七月六日至七日，普軍海軍陸戰隊夜渡登陸，未經攻城戰便奪取弗萊德里西亞，顯示內陸危機牽制了海灣城市的守禦。哥本哈根方面，普軍在七月十八日至十九日以重炮兵自迪弗爾高地對首都實施兩個夜晚的密集轟擊，砲兵集中、縱深有限的丹麥城防難以支撐，炮擊加上封鎖最終逼出停戰談判。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the Prussian-Danish War was long-range fire and engineering set against a defence built on fortresses. The Prussians gave up the dense columns of 1813 and used company-sized skirmish lines firing from trenches, tree lines and behind village houses; the needle gun's volleys of several rounds a minute were dense in fall of shot and rapid, and once the Danish defenders left their works they struggled to maintain the line, so the Prussians put their weight on blockade and siege artillery instead of an immediate assault. The general assault on Dybbol on 18 April was the Prussians' only frontal effort, and it failed: the Danes met it with the fire arcs of the works, with counter-attacks and with infantry support, and drove the attackers back, costing the allied army several hundred men in front of the ramparts. The Prussians then switched to a siege method of gradual approach, entrenchment and the placing of sixty or more heavy guns; the mass bombardment of 30 April, followed by a series of night attacks, eventually forced the Dybbol garrison to withdraw of its own accord between 4 and 5 May and to blow up the works, rather than being taken by storm. The Danish tactical core was to hold the bays and the island fortresses and drag the Prussians into a war of attrition. The navy swept the Sound with the ironclad, blocking the sea route by which the Prussians might land, and on 29 April, off Flensburg, the ship's ram struck the engine room and rudder of the Austrian armoured frigate Radetzky and drove her from the fight for several months. On 6 and 7 July the Prussian marines crossed by night and took Fredericia without any siege being fought, showing how the crisis in the interior had pulled the lagoon towns' garrisons thin. Against Copenhagen the Prussians concentrated their heavy artillery on the Dybbol heights and bombarded the capital on two consecutive nights, 18 and 19 July; the Danish works, with concentrated guns and limited depth, could not hold, and the shelling together with the blockade brought the armistice negotiations.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。普軍為此役動員的地面部隊約九萬至十一萬人，奧地利分遣隊約三萬至四萬人；丹麥陸軍可用兵力約二萬五千至三萬人，另有海軍與海灣要塞的守軍。迪弗爾的要塞守軍約三千五百人，配備四十餘門火砲，包圍它的普奧聯軍兵力在四萬以上；四月十八日總攻失利時，聯軍在前線傷亡以數百計。五月十九日至六月初，普軍把圍城砲兵增到六十門以上，四月三十日一天內對迪弗爾的射擊達數千發。一八六四年七月的哥本哈根轟擊，普軍集結約二百一十門火砲、逾四十處砲位，連續兩個夜晚轟擊城防與市區的軍用目標；丹麥在四月二十九日『羅夫·克拉克』號撞擊『拉德茨基』號一役中迫使其退出戰鬥數月。割讓地區的面積約一萬八千平方公里，人口合計約八十萬上下，其中石勒蘇益格約四十四萬、荷爾斯泰因約三十四萬、勞恩堡約五萬。戰費方面，聯軍以千萬塔勒計，丹麥的財政同樣吃緊，戰後不得不重訂軍制、兵役與預算。戰爭歷時約九個月，自二月一日開戰至十月三十日《維也納條約》簽訂。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Prussians mobilised about ninety to one hundred and ten thousand men on the ground for the campaign, and the Austrian detachment about thirty to forty thousand; Denmark had twenty-five to thirty thousand men available in the field, besides the navy and the garrisons of the lagoon fortresses. The garrison at Dybbol was about three thousand five hundred strong with forty-odd guns, and more than forty thousand allied troops were massed against it; in the failed assault of 18 April the allied army lost several hundred men in front of the works. Between 19 May and the beginning of June the Prussians raised their siege artillery to more than sixty guns, and on 30 April alone they fired several thousand rounds at Dybbol. In the July bombardment of Copenhagen the Prussians assembled about two hundred and ten guns in more than forty positions and shelled the works and the military targets in the city on two consecutive nights; the Danish ramming of the Radetzky by Rolf Krake on 29 April forced that Austrian ship out of the fight for several months. The ceded territory covered about eighteen thousand square kilometres and had a combined population of roughly eight hundred thousand, of whom some four hundred and forty thousand were in Schleswig, three hundred and forty thousand in Holstein and fifty thousand in Lauenburg. On costs, the allies' outlay ran to tens of millions of thalers, while Danish finances were strained too, and the country had to reorganise its army system, its conscription and its budget after the war. The war lasted about nine months, from 1 February to the signing of the Treaty of Vienna on 30 October.
cause: 起因是丹麥單方面修訂憲法，把石勒蘇益格正式併入王國。一八五二年的《倫敦議定書》把三公國的統治權交給丹麥，同時要求石勒蘇益格另具德意志邦聯成員國的地位；丹麥在荷爾斯泰因與石勒蘇益格的等級議會長期抵制中央化，六十年代轉向全民公投與新憲法的方向，一八六三年十一月憲法頒布，一八六四年三月一日的新憲法把石勒蘇益格整個納入王國，等於撕毀議定書。另一條導火線是地產階級的請願：一八六三年十二月二十日，荷爾斯泰因與石勒蘇益格的地產代表向德意志邦聯提出申訴，主張自身的邦聯成員權，同月普魯士境內出現布雷斯勞請願書，得到上千名公民聯署，要求邦聯維護兩公國的舊有地位。外交上，一八六二年的倫敦會議在英、法、俄三國調停下未能達成協議，丹麥的處境在談判中愈見孤立。普魯士的算盤是：奧地利與丹麥同樣不願看到石勒蘇益格脫離德意志邦聯，兩國利益重疊，可以暫時攜手；只要在丹麥境內打一場有限的戰爭，維也納就會被迫承認邦聯法的執行，奧地利在德國的事權也會繼續受制於普魯士。俾斯麥把這一切包裝成邦聯執法的技術動作，既在國內繞過議會，也在外交上避免與英國正面衝突。
causeEn: The cause was Denmark's unilateral revision of its constitution, folding Schleswig formally into the kingdom. The London Protocol of 1852 had handed the rule of the three duchies to Denmark while requiring that Schleswig should also be given the standing of a state within the German Confederation. The estates' assemblies of Holstein and Schleswig long resisted centralisation in Denmark, and the country moved in the sixties towards referendums and a new constitution: a constitution was promulgated in November 1863, and the new constitution of 1 March 1864 drew all of Schleswig into the kingdom, tearing up the protocol. A second fuse was the petition of the estates. On 20 December 1863 the estate representatives of Holstein and Schleswig appealed to the German Confederation, claiming their rights as members of the Confederation, and in the same month the Breslau petition in Prussia drew the signatures of more than a thousand citizens calling on the Confederation to maintain the old status of the two duchies. Diplomatically, the London conference of 1862, mediated by Britain, France and Russia, produced no agreement, and Denmark's position grew more isolated as the talks dragged on. Prussia's calculation was that Austria, like Denmark, did not want Schleswig to leave the German Confederation, so that the two interests overlapped and the two could act together for a time. One limited war inside Denmark would force Vienna to accept the execution of federal law, and Austrian affairs in Germany would remain subject to Prussia. Bismarck dressed all of this up as a technical act of federal execution, which sidestepped the parliament at home and avoided a direct confrontation with Britain abroad.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是丹麥失去石勒蘇益格、荷爾斯泰因與勞恩堡，國土縮減，也失去境內數十萬德語人口的忠誠；一八六四年十月三十日的《維也納條約》把三公國交給奧地利與普魯士共同佔領，此後便是長達半個多世紀的石勒蘇益格問題，一九二〇年三月北石勒蘇益格的公民投票把北部約三成面積、十四萬人口劃歸丹麥，一九三二年東荷爾斯泰因公民投票又以九成以上票數留在德國，界線就此固定，殘餘的德國少數族群問題一直延續到二十一世紀。更大的結構性影響在德國：普魯士藉一場為期數月的邊境戰爭證明自己比奧地利更有能力執行邦聯法，一八六五年《加施泰因條約》把兩公國的管治權單獨交給普魯士，一八六六年普丹矛盾轉化為普奧戰爭並導致德意志邦聯解體，一八六七年的北德意志邦聯使普魯士在漢諾威、黑森、拿騷及法蘭克福自由市取得直接統治，德國統一的路由此打開。技術上，戰爭也暴露了普軍針刺火槍並非無所不能：射速優勢不足以吃掉丹麥的堡壘與後膛砲，普軍不得不回到圍城砲兵，而同年下半年法國已在試製新式後膛砲，一八六六年戰爭後針刺火槍很快被新式後膛槍取代。國際層面上，英法俄的中立與事後施壓，顯示歐洲列強約束普魯士的能力有限，而丹麥的處境則把小國在歐洲均勢中的脆弱暴露無遺。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the war was that Denmark lost Schleswig, Holstein and Lauenburg, saw her territory shrink, and lost the loyalty of several hundred thousand German-speaking inhabitants. The Treaty of Vienna of 30 October 1864 handed the three duchies to the joint occupation of Austria and Prussia, and out of that came the Schleswig-Holstein question lasting more than half a century. In the plebiscite of March 1920 the northern part of Schleswig, roughly three tenths of its area and about one hundred and forty thousand people, went to Denmark, and in the plebiscite of 1932 the population of eastern Holstein voted by more than ninety per cent to stay with Germany; the frontier was thereby fixed, and the residual question of the German minority ran on into the twenty-first century. The larger structural effect fell on Germany. Prussia demonstrated through a war of a few months along a border that it could execute federal law more effectively than Austria could; the Gastein Convention of 1865 gave Prussia sole administration of the two duchies; the Prussian-Austrian quarrel of 1864 turned into the Austro-Prussian War of 1866 and the dissolution of the German Confederation; and the North German Confederation of 1867 put Hanover, Hesse, Nassau and the free city of Frankfurt under Prussian rule, opening the road to German unification. On the technical side the war also showed that the Prussian needle gun was not invincible: a rate of fire advantage was not enough to eat through the Danish works and breech-loading guns, the Prussians had to fall back on siege artillery, and while the French were already trying new breech-loaders in the second half of the same year, the needle gun was quickly replaced by new breech-loading rifles after 1866. On the international level, the neutrality and the subsequent pressure of Britain, France and Russia showed how limited the ability of the European powers to restrain Prussia was, while Denmark's plight exposed without disguise the fragility of small states in the European balance of power.
result: 結果是丹麥在軍事上被逐出西日德蘭，戰爭以割地收場而非以革新收場。一八六四年二月一日，普奧聯軍越過埃德河進入荷爾斯泰因，六月二十六日聯邦執行軍佔領荷爾斯泰因全境，七月一日普軍越過埃德河進入石勒蘇益格，九日奧地利正式對丹麥宣戰。丹麥的堡壘沒有被正面強攻攻破：四月十八日迪弗爾的防守成功逼退了普軍第一次總攻，但隨著普軍圍城砲兵到位，四月三十日的大規模轟擊加之以後數週的壕溝作業與夜襲，五月四日至五日守軍主動撤出並炸毀迪弗爾工事，荷爾斯泰因與石勒蘇益格全境隨之易手。丹麥軍隊未潰散，退往北方重整防線，六月二十五日在伊斯特德與奧軍交戰又取勝，但戰略空間已被壓縮；海軍四月二十九日的撞擊雖重創『拉德茨基』號，也未能扭轉制海權。七月六日至七日普軍海軍陸戰隊在弗萊德里西亞登陸成功，暴露了海灣守禦的漏洞；七月十八日至十九日對哥本哈根的炮擊更直接擊穿城防，迫使丹麥在七月二十日接受停戰談判，八月一日停戰生效，十月三十日《維也納條約》把三公國割予奧地利與普魯士，丹麥軍隊退回本土，戰俘交換完畢，軍械與旗幟一併撤出。戰爭之後的一八六六年，普魯士以石勒蘇益格問題為藉口向奧地利開戰，把一八六四年的成果一口氣併入北德意志邦聯，兩個公國隨後成為德國版圖的一部分。
resultEn: The result was that Denmark was driven out of western Jutland militarily, and the war ended in a cession of territory rather than in any reform. On 1 February 1864 the allied Austro-Prussian forces crossed the Eider into Holstein; on 26 June the federal execution corps occupied all of Holstein; on 1 July the Prussians crossed the Eider into Schleswig, and on the 9th Austria formally declared war on Denmark. The Danish works were not carried by frontal assault. The defence of Dybbol on 18 April turned back the Prussians' first general assault, but once the Prussian siege artillery was in position, the mass bombardment of 30 April, followed by weeks of trench work and night attacks, forced the garrison to withdraw of its own accord between 4 and 5 May and blow up the Dybbol works, and all of Holstein and Schleswig fell with them. The Danish army did not break up; it withdrew north, reorganised its line, and on 25 June defeated the Austrians at Isted, though its room for manoeuvre had been compressed. The naval ramming of 29 April badly damaged the Radetzky but could not turn the command of the sea. On 6 and 7 July the Prussian marines landed successfully at Fredericia, exposing the holes in the lagoon garrisons' defence, and the bombardment of Copenhagen on 18 and 19 July broke through the city's works and forced Denmark to open armistice negotiations on 20 July; the armistice took effect on 1 August, and on 30 October the Treaty of Vienna ceded the three duchies to Austria and Prussia, the Danish army withdrawing to the homeland, prisoners exchanged, and guns and colours carried away. In 1866, following the war, Prussia used the Schleswig-Holstein question as the pretext for war on Austria and swallowed the results of 1864 whole into the North German Confederation, and the two duchies became part of the German map.
